title: Prepare premises proof and identity documents
description: Gather proof that you occupy the business premises (rent agreement or ownership document) plus ID proof of the owner/partners before starting the online application.
documents: Rent agreement or property ownership proof

title: Register/login on Aaple Sarkar and select Shops & Establishments service
description: Create an account on the Aaple Sarkar portal (or log in if you already have one) and select 'Registration of Shop and Establishment' under the Labour Department.
dependencyReason: Portal account and service selection come before document upload, but premises/ID documents should be ready first so the form can be filled in one sitting

title: Fill application form and upload documents
description: Enter business name, address, nature of business, employer details, and number of employees. Upload scanned copies of all supporting documents.
documents: Scanned copies of documents from Step 1
dependencyReason: Requires an active portal session and the correct service to be selected first

title: Pay government fee
description: Pay the applicable government fee online. NOTE: exact fee is not confirmed from an official source yet — third-party sources quote figures ranging from roughly ₹100 up to several thousand rupees depending on employee count and registration type (intimation vs. license), and MUST be verified on the live portal.
fee: unverified — confirm on aaplesarkar.mahaonline.gov.in at application time
dependencyReason: Payment is only enabled after the form is complete and submitted

title: Verification and certificate issuance
description: The application and documents are reviewed by the department. Once approved, the Gumasta registration certificate is issued and sent to the registered email.
processingTime: unverified — third-party sources suggest 3-5 working days, not confirmed against an official source
dependencyReason: Department review only begins after payment is confirmed
